summary: Allow the existing historical upgrade fixture to validate same-target maintenance transitions.
details: The manifest-driven harness previously rejected every historical 4.2.0 CCC00 to 4.2.1 CCC01 transition because its fixture specialization selected only MIR 3 terminal predecessors.

A shared transition resolver retains the exact terminal paths and admits strictly earlier same-target MIR 4.2 maintenance versions through the existing distribution codec and continuity fixture. Equal versions, downgrades, wrong targets and malformed identities are refused.

Focused tests cover all five historical targets and preserve their engine-line and infinite-research selections. Actual published predecessor custody, candidate-bound native execution, reload proof and current-version engine-runner admission remain outstanding.
